description: This source file implements a firmware cutter tool for Arcadyan W921V devices. It reads a firmware binary, decrypts and extracts embedded partitions, particularly those compressed with LZMA, and saves them as separate files based on their type.

methods.name: part_type
methods.description: Determines the partition type based on an ID, returning the filename for the extracted partition.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that handles firmware file reading, decryption, partition extraction, and saving.
